prediction_text: The thief is a waterman — one who works upon the water / about the barges. Jupiter, the only peregrine planet in an angle, on the cusp of the 7th in Scorpio, a moist sign, is the thief's significator: a man of the river trade. The goods are near water and not carried far: Mercury, significator of the goods, is in Pisces (a moist sign) and the Part of Fortune in Cancer (a moist sign) — the fish lies in a moist place by the water, about the warehouse/wharf quarter. Recovery: partial — Mercury is in his fall and detriment (the goods damaged/diminished) but in his own terms, applied to by sextile of the Moon, lady of the Part of Fortune, and in trine to the Part of Fortune itself: a part of the goods may be recovered, not the whole, and with trouble. Mars, lord of the 7th, leaving his own sign Scorpio, shows the thief already quitting the place.
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：谁窃（主问）、物在何处、能否找回。断项过闸：窃者为水上营生者←七宫头角上独一无定位行星木星居蝎（湿宫）为贼象征；物近水未远←货物象征水星居鱼（湿宫）、福点居蟹（湿宫）两路同指湿处（粒度：区域级，两指针同向保留）；部分找回←水星弱而居自界、得月六合与福点三合。对象核：承受对象=失窃之鱼货（非人对象），应验同为鱼货。
